title: Release v1.36.8 (installer startup robustness)
summary: NOT SUBMITTED FOR v1.36.8. This release stops the installer and updater from treating a slow start as a failed one, normalises pasted recovery phrases, and removes a misleading IPv6 probe error. It changes no consensus state and no transaction execution. It therefore registers no chain upgrade handler and must not schedule a software-upgrade halt. scripts/test_upgrade.sh reads the plan name below, confirms that no matching handler exists, and requires --no-chain-upgrade so the complete deployment and test rehearsal still runs without proposing a halt.
